propositions: Oversized ticket descriptions materially degrade plan-review latency and completion-verification PASS rates, with descriptions ≥8,000 characters showing median 553.7s plan-review time and only 50.0% completion PASS versus 74.3% below the threshold.

Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when ticket description exceeds the configured 8,000-character maximum, with light-bug review retaining the blocking P4 description finding while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.

Completion verification must check the authoritative ticket description immediately after loading the [verify] configuration and before child checks, returning validated deterministic FAIL with an actionable split/shorten finding and zero runner calls if the description exceeds the maximum.

The 8,000-character limit applies uniformly across bug, story, task, and epic tickets as a generous tail-cutoff just above p99 (7,500 chars) that affects only 0.82% of historical work tickets while capturing the pain range with materially worse performance metrics.
